security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Pocket Sheets is a spreadsheet app that lives entirely on your device. A grid with formulas, multiple sheets, sorting and filtering, a Cards view, and import and export in .xlsx, .csv and the open Weave (.weave) format. No account, no cloud, no network — your work never leaves your machine.
bundle.shortDescription: Pocket Sheets — a spreadsheet app that lives on your device.
